items.text: the performance board (Pro, open in beta), for playing live with the output on another screen. In the Room tool: board. The stage takes the output's shape (16:9 until one is open) in the top corner; beside it, the panels you open stay open side by side, and a new one replaces the oldest when there is no room; under the stage, a strip of the controls you play most

the strip is yours: hold a control (or tap the pencil) and everything jiggles: drag to reorder, × takes one off, + adds buttons and sliders (sound level, flow, speed, strength, reach, trails and more). Five boards come with it (Play, Scenes, Sound, Color, Touch), the stage can sit left or right, and save board keeps your own
the board needs a window at least 900 × 560; on a phone the stage stays as it is
in the random matrix the ground's row just says Ground (still off until you switch it on)
a short shelf above the bar sits over its button; a shelf as wide as the bar or wider sits centred over the bar, and only its little point moves to its button

saving a scene shows it was saved, where the button was: the scene's picture, a check, its number among yours and its name. Tap the name to rename it there and then; the button comes back after a few seconds, or with done
while you are in a room, the Room tool's tile shows the moving dots under it, like the text tool while its words play
the output window no longer freezes a second after you make it full screen on the same display. The browser stops animating a window that is covered; the output window now keeps Current moving itself

the index no longer jitters up and down when it is just a little taller than the screen (a Room tap could start it): the version and copyright at its foot open when you reach the end and stay open until you scroll back up
the beat grid's clear button is an eraser
with the Room tool, the shelf under the bar no longer opens empty, and the little caret under the tools button goes away; it comes back with any tool that has something below

the water is split in two. The shelf under the bar keeps the waters themselves (Shallows, Deep, Harbor…): tap one, tap it again for dry. Its settings moved up into a Water tab in the Sound panel, in two groups, Sound (depth, bed, voices) and Surface (its kind, what makes the ripples, its colors)
no more "none" and "both" choices. Voices are two switches, touch and music: light either, both, or neither for no voices. Bed and surface clear when you tap the lit one again
a shelf is as wide as its icons and sits centred over the button that opened it, instead of a wide box with the icons at one end; it still stays on screen, and scrolls when it has more than fits
